title: POP KIT Deck JSON
description: Contract between the Nugget Builder (assets tool) and the v10 render route. Base shape from references/motion-and-feedback.md; additions are marked in each description.

v.description: Schema version, so the render route can refuse a deck it predates.

canvas.description: A preset in the kit's tokens.js CANVAS table.

video.description: ADDED in v10. The paired video, same basename as this file. Duration and dimensions let the render route reject a deck paired with the wrong clip.

protectedRegions.description: ADDED in v10. Rectangles an arrow tip must not land on without the wider clearance arrows.md requires.

t.description: Entrance, seconds from the start of the video.

out.description: ADDED in v10. Explicit exit in seconds, so the render route never infers dwell.

variant.description: Template variant id, e.g. M01. Carried through from the v9 example.

caption.description: ADDED in v10. Caption shell id, catalogue page K.

colorway.description: ADDED in v10. One of the 8 colourways.

align.description: CLARIFIED in v10. Present in the v9 example but not a compose() option; compose() ignores it. Defined here as which point on the composed cluster the anchor refers to: its left edge, centre, or right edge, vertically centred.

medallion.description: ADDED in v10. Mirrors compose()'s left/right medallion option; a catalogue ID alone cannot rebuild the call.

media.description: ADDED in v10. A picture or clip in the shape instead of a flat fill, which media-wells.md calls a well. Always a data URI: there is no asset server, and a deck pointing at one would stop rendering the moment it moved.

mediaFit.description: ADDED in v10. preserveAspectRatio for the media. Defaults to xMidYMid slice.

mediaIsVideo.description: ADDED in v10. True when media is a clip. An SVG <image> cannot hold one, so a video well is drawn by the renderer rather than by compose(). The skill's render route refuses a deck containing one.

glyphFrac.description: ADDED in v10. Glyph size as a fraction of the frame's safe box. compose() defaults to 0.86, which on a circle leaves the artwork under half the medallion diameter once the glyph SVG's own halo margin is accounted for.

arrows.description: ADDED in v10. Mirrors compose()'s arrows array. Field names match references/compose-api.md exactly.

size.description: ADDED in v10. Arrow size in canvas px, overriding scale. A standalone arrow has no medallion to be a multiple of.

over.description: arrows.md: a popup arrow should usually set this false so its tail tucks under the caption. Superseded by layer, which is read first; kept because v9 decks set it.

layer.description: ADDED in v10. Draw layer. under = behind the whole caption (the old over:false), which swallows an arrow lying mostly over the shell. mid = above the shell, below the medallion, still beneath the copy. over = above everything.

cue.description: One of the nine cues in the sound pack, or none.

haptic.description: Pinned. motion-and-feedback.md: haptics are 'only in the product, never on a social asset'. Kept for forward compatibility only.

override.description: ADDED in v10. Records a dwell trimmed below its computed floor. motion-and-feedback.md calls such a trim 'a flagged compromise, not routine practice', so it is recorded rather than applied silently.

maxTextW.description: ADDED in v10. Wrap width in canvas px; compose()'s main size dial. Defaults to 62% of canvas width, which overflows a vertical frame once a medallion and arrow are attached.

fontSize.description: ADDED in v10. Overrides the canvas base font size.

overlap.description: ADDED in v10. How far the medallion laps over the caption end; compose() defaults to 0.30. Moves the medallion along the caption without changing its distance from the text.

captionPadL.description: ADDED in v10. Caption padding on the left end only, in px. Sets the medallion-to-text gap, which is otherwise constant regardless of medallion size. Per-end so closing the gap on the medallion's side does not drag the far end in with it.

captionPadR.description: ADDED in v10. Caption padding on the right end only, in px. See captionPadL.

medallionScale.description: ADDED in v10. Medallion diameter as a multiple of caption height. compose() defaults to 1.52; the builder opens beats at 1.15. Carried here so the render route draws the size that was approved rather than the kit default.

well.description: ADDED in v10. A media well: a framed hole holding a picture or a clip, drawn by media.js rather than compose(). Wells are not square, so a medallion cannot express one.

template.description: W01..W10, when it came from one of the named formats.

shape.description: Template wells only. Ignored when frame is set.

src.description: The picture or clip, as a data URI. There is no asset server.

poster.description: A still for a clip, used anywhere video cannot be drawn.

frame.description: ADDED in v10. A shape well: one of the eighteen medallion frames holding the media, drawn by compose() rather than media.js. Mutually exclusive with template.

from.description: Seconds. Omit both from and to for a mark on screen the whole time.
